notes: One instance only — duplicate copies can no longer stack up
patch_notes:
Single-instance guard: launching GameMode VPN while it is already running no longer opens a second copy — it tells you the app is already running (check the window or the tray icon) and exits.
This fixes a real stall: several stacked copies (some hidden in the tray) kept the updater waiting forever for every copy to close before it could rebuild. The guard fails open: if it cannot check, the app starts anyway.
